title: Putnami Lifecycle Phases
description: Defines the standard lifecycle phases that extensions implement as commands. Phases execute in dependency order and can be composed into pipelines.

workloadTypes.description: Workload types this phase applies to.

dependsOn.description: Phases that must complete before this phase runs.

Phases.description: The ordered list of standard lifecycle phases with their metadata.

default.name: generate
default.description: Code generation from schemas, protobuf, OpenAPI, or other sources. Produces source files that subsequent phases consume.

default.name: build
default.description: Compile, transpile, and bundle source code into executable artifacts. Includes type checking for statically typed languages.

default.name: test
default.description: Execute test suites and report results as diagnostics. Produces coverage metrics and test reports.

default.name: lint
default.description: Static analysis, formatting checks, and code style enforcement. Produces diagnostics for violations.

default.name: format
default.description: Auto-format source code according to project conventions. Modifies files in place.

default.name: serve
default.description: Start the workload in development mode with file watching and hot reload. Only meaningful for service and worker workloads.

default.name: run
default.description: Build the workload for the host, run it once with environment passthrough, and forward the child process exit code. Used for local validation of one-shot Jobs (migrations, batch workloads) and short-lived commands.

default.name: publish
default.description: Publish packages to a registry (npm, Go modules, PyPI, container registry).

default.name: package
default.description: Create distributable packages (tarballs, container images, binaries) without publishing.

HookPoint.description: Named point in the lifecycle where extensions can inject custom logic.

HookDefinition.description: A hook that runs at a specific lifecycle point.

kind.description: Hook execution kind. Currently only 'command' is supported.

cwd.description: Working directory for the hook command.

inputs.description: File patterns that affect cache validity.

outputs.description: File patterns produced by the hook.

dependsOn.description: Other hooks that must run first.
